title: Epinephrine Dose: Optimal Versus Standard Evaluation Trial
official: CanROC Epinephrine Dose: Optimal Versus Standard Evaluation Trial (CanROC EpiDOSE Trial)
summary: The objective of this randomized controlled trial is to evaluate whether a low cumulative dose of epinephrine ("low dose") is non-inferior to a standard cumulative dose of epinephrine ("standard dose") with respect to survival to hospital discharge among adults undergoing resuscitation for OHCA due to ventricular fibrillation (VF) or pulseless ventricular tachycardia (pVT).
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Out-of-hospital cardiac arrest treated by paramedics AND
* Initial recorded cardiac rhythm of VF or pulseless VT, or, AED shock on first analysis administered or confirmed by paramedics or fire services, AND
* Established intravenous vascular access

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known or apparent age \<18 years
* Initial recorded cardiac rhythm of VF or pulseless VT, or, AED shock on first analysis administered or confirmed by paramedics
* Cardiac arrest due to an obvious non-cardiac primary cause (e.g. blunt or penetrating trauma, exsanguination, burns, drug overdose, drowning, anaphylaxis, sudden asphyxiation, etc.)
* Administration of intramuscular, endotracheal tube, or intraosseous epinephrine
* Prisoners or persons in police custody
* Known allergy or sensitivity to epinephrine
